help_text:
How to complete a task

1. Choose a service.
2. Send your content and follow the prompts.
3. Review the cost and confirm execution.
4. Receive the result here and track progress in My orders.

Credit is reserved only after confirmation. Navigation preserves your draft; selecting a service starts a new draft.

/menu Home
/services Services
/orders My orders
/wallet Credit
/resume Resume draft
/cancel Cancel draft or leave support
/lang Language
/support Contact support

Credit is for testing only. Temporary files are deleted automatically; save your result when it arrives.
